title: campanula lanceolata var. hirsuta
intro: Campanula lanceolata var. hirsuta, commonly known as hairy bellflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy bellflower are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
